title: The fixed integral and completion comparisons share the normalized completed shift
statement: Fix l,E and an immersion g:Y→X. Supply the published IntegralCompletedComparison.Comparison C, completeness of back(K) for every integral constructible K, a natural isomorphism gamma from the integral functor to the strict completed functor with the exact normalization formula of [def-sf-integral-immersion-pullback-normalization-data], and a natural isomorphism c from ordinary to completed whose hom is the actual completion unit. There exists one coherent shift structure on the ambient strict completed functor for which gamma and c both commute with all integer shifts, using C.derivedShift on integral pullback and the canonical termwise ordinary shift. The isomorphisms, their naturality and normalization are hypotheses, not conclusions; exactness, linearity and constructibility are not asserted.

proof.text: Immersion module inverse image is exact and preserves countable products. Exact products compute the strict derived limit by the normalized Roos cone. The quotient augmentation has coordinates (0,(x mod t^n)_n), and the canonical shift sends (y,x) to ((-1)^r y,x). Thus the augmentation intertwines every integer shift, with the zero and addition coherences.

Transport this single shift along the exact coefficient restrictions. The sectionwise-identity round trip commutes with termwise shifts. The preceding normalized augmentation square gives c compatibility. Compose C.shifts with the unit-normalized strict/reflector comparison, represented by the same quotient maps and signed Roos shift, and the round-trip square. This gives gamma compatibility for precisely the same completed shift. The hypotheses identify the actual comparison maps, so no arbitrary isomorphism is substituted.

theorem immersion_comparison_shifts
    (C : IntegralCompletedComparison.Comparison l E g)
    (hc : ∀ K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X,
      IntegralCompletedComparison.Complete l E ((back l E X).obj K.obj))
    (γ : (sfIntegralConstructible l E X).ι ⋙ integralDerivedPullback l E g ≅
      (sfIntegralConstructible l E X).ι ⋙ completed l E g)
    (hγ : ∀ K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X,
      γ.hom.app K =
        (integralDerivedPullback l E g).map ((roundTrip l E X).inv.app K.obj) ≫
        (C.gamma ((back l E X).obj K.obj) (hc K)).hom ≫
        (ImmersionCompletedPullback.transport l E Y).map
          ((IntegralCompletedComparison.towerIso l E g).inv.app
            ⟨(back l E X).obj K.obj, C.intrinsic ((back l E X).obj K.obj) (hc K)⟩))
    (c : (sfIntegralConstructible l E X).ι ⋙ ordinary l E g ≅
      (sfIntegralConstructible l E X).ι ⋙ completed l E g)
    (hc' : c.hom = whiskerLeft (sfIntegralConstructible l E X).ι
      (completionComparison l E g)) :
    ∃ sc : (completed l E g).CommShift ℤ,
      (fun [_si : (integralDerivedPullback l E g).CommShift ℤ]
        [_sc : (completed l E g).CommShift ℤ] ↦ NatTrans.CommShift γ.hom ℤ)
          (_si := C.derivedShift) (_sc := sc) ∧
      (fun [_sc : (completed l E g).CommShift ℤ] ↦ NatTrans.CommShift c.hom ℤ)
        (_sc := sc)
